target: acceptance 3 — a consolidator that quietly drops a distinct learning passes a naive line-count assertion while destroying the thing the file exists for
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/distinct.md" t.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" consolidate t.md >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; a=$(grep -c alpha t.md); b=$(grep -c beta t.md); g=$(grep -c gamma t.md); printf '{"rc":%s,"a":%s,"b":%s,"g":%s}' "$rc" "$a" "$b" "$g"
